predictions.text: Silent Hill F better than TownFall: I just completed Silent Hill Townfall, and this is the only Silent Hill game where I put it on Story Mode because I got tired of playing it. It was a slog to me, honestly. Once I got to Richard’s part, which I found pretty boring, and then Simon’s part, where I had to do one of the worst puzzles in gaming history that I’ve ever experienced, I was completely over it. I’d definitely take Silent Hill f again. The final boss fight was a joke as well. Silent Hill f had better characters, story, boss fights, replay value, better enemy variety and better environments.
